name: funding-extraction-harness-benchmark
description: Benchmark for extracting funding-related metadata (e.g., funders, grant numbers, and funding statements) from scholarly text. It measures a model's ability to identify and correctly extract structured funding information from publication texts and metadata. The tasks focus on precision and recall of extracted fields to support downstream metadata curation and analysis.
reputation: A niche, task-focused benchmark on Hugging Face used by researchers and developers working on scholarly metadata extraction and information retrieval.
